title: 生物发光
prompt: [SUBJECT] depicted as a Mythical Creature Luminescence, with glowing edges that accentuate the fantastical and legendary aspects. Utilize [COLOR1] and [COLOR2] to enhance the mythical and enchanting qualities.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作出带有发光边缘的奇幻生物插画，非常适合图书封面和游戏素材，突出神话动物的迷人光芒与传奇氛围。
